threat_event: CUI is processed or stored outside the authorized enclave (PDPP, commercial email, AI tools)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Enclave 'field release' export; no CUI upload block in the PDPP; field staff not trained on CUI; 1,140 CUI files found in the PDPP on 2026-07-14
existing_controls: Enclave on a FedRAMP Moderate authorized offering; DoD report filed 2026-07-16; files restricted to administrators
treatment_plan: Remove field release export; enclave desktops for superintendents; CUI upload block and purge in the PDPP; CUI training for 1,200 field staff

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects progress payments, subcontractor payments, or tenant rent across divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Free-text remittance block on pay applications; Property AP outside the payment factory; owners and tenants not told the verification procedure; 23 property domains at DMARC monitor-only
affected_asset_or_process: PDPP pay applications; SYS-G4; SYS-D3; SYS-G5
existing_controls: Payment factory call-back and dual approval; phishing-resistant MFA for payment roles; DMARC reject on group domains
treatment_plan: Validated remittance block from SYS-G4; move Property AP into the payment factory; owner and tenant remittance letters; DMARC reject on property domains

threat_event: Loss of DoD contract eligibility because CMMC statuses are inaccurate or the enclave is not ready for Level 2 (C3PAO)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: March 2026 self-assessment overstated readiness; enclave SSP outdated; requirements worth 5 points not met; CMMC Phase 2 (planned for 2026-11-10) is suspended, but SP 800-171 Rev. 2 under DFARS 252.204-7012 still applies
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G6; PDPP Level 1 scope; SPRS records
existing_controls: Director of Federal Contracts Compliance; internal audit pre-assessment; outside government contracts counsel
treatment_plan: Counsel review of the March affirmation and SPRS record; close 3.1.20, 3.12.4, 3.4.8, and 3.2.2 before a C3PAO assessment; independent re-test

threat_event: A cross-division incident misses a notice deadline (DoD 72 hours, state laws, owners, tenants, SEC)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Notification matrix not exercised across divisions; owner, tenant, and surety terms missing; intercompany prime and subcontractor reporting not defined
existing_controls: Group POL-03; DIBNet medium assurance certificate held
treatment_plan: Complete matrix; cross-division tabletop with a materiality decision

threat_event: Ransomware spreads through shared services and halts project delivery in several divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared identity and integration services connect all divisions; jobsite networks and design workstations are broad targets
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR; PAM; immutable backups in provider B
treatment_plan: Quarterly restore tests including the PDPP export; jobsite network segmentation; cross-division tabletop

threat_event: Compromise of owned-building systems disrupts tenants and life-safety interfaces at several properties
threat_source: Ransomware group or intruder through an integrator
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat building networks at 41 properties; 11 integrators with persistent remote access; no SOC monitoring; default controller passwords
existing_controls: Local control of life-safety systems; on-site engineers
treatment_plan: Segment building networks; integrator access through group PAM; onboard BAS servers to the SIEM; credential reset program

threat_event: Covered telecommunications or video surveillance equipment is provided to or used for the Government
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No group approved-manufacturer list; A&E specifications and Property procurement not screened
affected_asset_or_process: TSSI installations; owned buildings; A&E specifications
existing_controls: TSSI submittal screening
treatment_plan: Group approved-manufacturer list; screening in A&E specifications and Property purchasing; replace covered cameras at 2 properties

threat_event: AI tools are used in bids, designs, hiring, and buildings without adequate governance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Rapid rollout of the AI estimating assistant; resume screening pilot; generative design assistant; Group AI Standard adopted after use began
existing_controls: Group AI Standard (2026); enterprise terms for SYS-D6
treatment_plan: Group AI program conditions (P10)

threat_event: A subcontractor or subconsultant without the required CMMC status receives FCI or CUI, or is used as an attack path
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No status check in SPRS before award; about 9,000 subcontractors and 400 subconsultants
existing_controls: Updated 2025 subcontract templates with flowdowns
treatment_plan: Status check step before award; quarterly re-check of active DoD subcontractors

threat_event: Outage or breach at the project management SaaS vendor stops project delivery for all divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One vendor holds all project records; export restore tested once
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2; nightly independent export
treatment_plan: Restore test with project teams; exit plan
owner: PDPP system owner (Group project delivery platform director)

threat_event: Insider misuses privileged access to client systems, designs, or payment data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: TSSI technicians hold client credentials; designers handle CUI; payment staff hold bank access
existing_controls: PAM with recording; same-day disablement
treatment_plan: Session analytics for TSSI and enclave; departure reviews for designers

threat_event: Division supplements drift and Property inheritance stays undocumented, hiding control failures
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Property supplement last aligned 2024; Property inheritance not documented
existing_controls: Annual policy review
treatment_plan: Re-issue Property supplement; inheritance matrix; annual attestation

threat_event: Workforce and craft personal information is exposed (certified payrolls, HR files)
threat_source: Attacker in a mailbox; misdirected email
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Subcontractor certified payrolls with full Social Security numbers arrive by email to project accountants
regulatory_driver: State breach laws (Fla. Stat. 501.171 worked example); FAR 52.222-8
existing_controls: Email encryption available; payroll SaaS access controls
treatment_plan: Certified payroll intake through the PDPP with masked numbers; mailbox retention limits

threat_event: Disclosure committee makes a late or unsupported materiality decision after a cyber incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Committee has not practiced a cyber scenario
existing_controls: Charter covers cybersecurity; escalation within 24 hours (POL-03)
treatment_plan: Include a materiality decision in the cross-division tabletop

threat_event: A cloud misconfiguration exposes project or facility data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Many division accounts; guardrails cover most services
existing_controls: Guardrails; posture monitoring
treatment_plan: Extend guardrails to the digital twin storage policies

threat_event: A hurricane disrupts Florida headquarters, jobsites, and properties at the same time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Headquarters, 19 properties, and many jobsites are in Florida
existing_controls: Cloud-hosted systems; remote work; hurricane plans per site
treatment_plan: Joint hurricane exercise across divisions

threat_event: Parking card payment environment fails PCI DSS validation or is breached
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pay stations share networks with BAS at 6 garages; segmentation not tested
existing_controls: Provider handles cardholder data
treatment_plan: Segment pay stations; segmentation testing; third-party service provider monitoring

threat_event: Client facility security details or owners' facility data are exposed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: TSSI holds client credentials; digital twin hosts facility data for 52 owners; tenant security layouts shared in the PDPP
existing_controls: Credential vault; tenant isolation
treatment_plan: Restrict security layouts to named users; client credential rotation at handover

threat_event: Group identity platform outage stops all divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single identity platform for all divisions
existing_controls: Break-glass accounts tested quarterly; vendor multi-region
treatment_plan: Annual identity outage exercise

threat_event: An internet-facing portal (PDPP portals, tenant portal, digital twin) is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Several vendor and group portals
existing_controls: Annual penetration tests; vendor patching
treatment_plan: Add the tenant portal and digital twin to the 2027 penetration test scope
